subject: general
question: Damodar Valley Corporation operates:
solution:
The correct answer is __**thermal power stations**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) is a statutory body established in 1948 under the Damodar Valley Corporation Act, 1948.
 
• DVC operates several thermal power stations in the Damodar River region of West Bengal and Jharkhand.
 
• DVC's power plants contribute significantly to the power supply in the region, making it a key player in the energy sector.
 
• The corporation's thermal power plants have a combined installed capacity of over 6,000 MW, making it one of the largest power producers in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC)**

 
 
• DVC was the first multipurpose river valley project undertaken by the Government of India after independence.
 
• The main objectives of DVC include flood control, irrigation, generation, and transmission of electric power, and the promotion of public health and agriculture within the Damodar Valley region.
 
• DVC operates several thermal power stations, including the ones at Bokaro, Chandrapura, Mejia, and Durgapur.
 
• In addition to thermal power generation, DVC also engages in hydroelectric power generation, coal mining, and the development of infrastructure such as irrigation canals and dams.
 
 
 
• **Thermal Power Stations**
 
 
• Thermal power stations convert heat energy from burning fossil fuels such as coal, oil, or natural gas into electrical energy.
 
• The process involves heating water in a boiler to produce steam, which then drives a steam turbine connected to an electricity generator.
 
• Thermal power plants are a major source of electricity and play a crucial role in meeting the energy demands of a country.
 
• Environmental concerns related to thermal power plants include air pollution from the burning of fossil fuels and the disposal of ash and other waste products.
